prompt:

Valid answers (choose exactly one): BUY, HOLD, SELL.
Company information (as of 2026-04-30):
| Return 3m            | +8.5% |
| Return 1m            | +0.2% |
| Return 1w            | +3.0% |
| Range position (63d) | 78% |
| 21d realized vol     | 18% |
| Last close           | 96.70 |
Reason briefly in 1-3 sentences. Then, on a separate final line, output exactly:
DECISION: <one label>
raw_response:
The stock shows stronger momentum over the last 3 months and a solid 1-week gain, with a relatively elevated 21-day realized volatility indicating active trading but still within a constructive range. The 63-day range position at 78% suggests it is not at an extreme, supporting continued participation. Overall, the setup favors near-term upside over the next 20 trading days.

DECISION: BUY
